title: Bounded setup run
statement: Let $a,b,f,X,Y,B$ be natural numbers with $a\le b$, $2X+2\le Y$, and $Y+8\bigl(2^{b\ell(X)+f}\bigr)^2\le B$. For any Boolean mode, finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, and Boolean word $y$, the register program with its oracle determined by $N$ has a finite run from the copy phase, starting with $y$-register $Y$, pointer $2X+2$, and all other registers zero, to the width-check phase. Its final registers are $Y$, $2X+2$, $X$, $0$, $0$, $a\ell(X)$, $b\ell(X)+f$, $2\cdot2^{b\ell(X)+f}$, $2(2^{b\ell(X)+f})^2$, $4(2^{b\ell(X)+f})^2$, $2X+2$, $0$, $0$, $0$, $0$, in register order; at every configuration before the endpoint, the program's guard holds and every register is at most $B$.
replaced:
Let $a,b,f,X,Y,B$ be natural numbers with $a\le b$, $2X+2\le Y$, and
$Y+8\bigl(2^{b\ell(X)+f}\bigr)^2\le B$. For any Boolean mode, finite nondeterministic
Turing machine $N$, and binary input $y$, the specified register program, using the
oracle determined by $N$, has a finite run from its copy phase with registers $y=Y$,
$p=2X+2$, and all other registers zero to its width-check phase with registers $y=Y$,
$p=2X+2$, $x=X$, $s=a\ell(X)$, $e=b\ell(X)+f$, $n=2\cdot2^e$, $m=2(2^e)^2$,
$k=4(2^e)^2$, and all other registers zero; at every configuration before the final one,
its instruction satisfies the guard and every register is at most $B$.
